overview: Main Overworld contains Starter Town and the surrounding resource and combat areas. After Tutorial Island, use the town to bank, trade, make equipment, and begin quests.
whyItMatters: Chickens and rats offer early combat practice, while goblins, boars, wolves, guards, and other enemies populate the surrounding areas. Bring food and check an enemy's aggression before approaching it.
howToGetStarted: Find the bank, general store, furnace, and anvil in Starter Town before heading out. Use Talk-to on NPCs to learn their services and quest requirements.
Visit Tanner Rusk at the tannery for Hides of the Frontier. His quest needs boar tusks and wolf fangs; prepare a weapon and cooked food before hunting boars and wolves.
connectedSystems: The town includes the Fishing Supplier and Teacher, Crafting Teacher, Tanner Rusk, Borin Ironvein, Thrain Deepforge, Elira Gemhand, Rune Tutor, and Combination Sage. Some merchant access depends on quests.
Resource routes lead to ore, coal, gems, rune essence, five wood types, fishing water, and the four elemental altars. Use the route and service locations below to plan a trip.
nextSteps: Choose a gathering or equipment goal, gather its materials, and return to the appropriate station. Bank unused supplies before exploring farther from town.
The retired standalone North Road Camp region is not a destination in the current game.

overview: Tutorial Island is the starting world for new characters. Its instructors introduce gathering, food, forging, melee, ranged, magic, runecrafting, crafting, and banking before you enter Main Overworld.
whyItMatters: Tutorial gates and practical checks track what you have completed. Follow the guidance marker and speak to the current instructor before practising.
howToGetStarted: Speak to the Tutorial Guide in the cabin and choose I am ready. Visit each instructor, complete their activity, and return to report your result.
The bank lesson requires a deposit at one booth and a withdrawal at the other. Once the Bank Tutor accepts that proof, speak to the Tutorial Guide to leave.
connectedSystems: Tutorial Island uses the same inventory, equipment, skills, and shared bank as Main Overworld. It includes chickens for combat practice and instructor recovery supplies.
nextSteps: Open How to play for the lesson order and common sticking points, then continue the early progression journey in Main Overworld.
